conversation-issues.description: A follow-up loses the earlier context, repeats the same results, or is read as a new question.

database-access.description: The graph holds no or too few events for what was asked (place, dates, genre), or could not be reached.

location-and-distance.description: A place or near-me ask goes wrong: no location to search from, no widening around a named town or neighbourhood, or a radius that is too small.

name-spelling.description: A named artist, venue or event is not found because the name is spelled or written differently from the graph.

query-interpretation.description: The ask is misread (date window, genre, kind of request), or the answer only suggests other searches instead of answering.

successful-event-query.description: The system finds and presents relevant events for the user's query.

unwanted-reply-text.description: The reply's wording is unwanted: it names the events the cards already show, or its tone or length is off.

wrong-event-data.description: An event's details are wrong or duplicated: date, time, venue, name.
